review_description: Although our original enquiry and agreement was on 29/3/11, panels were not put on roof until 17/6/11.  Then there was holdup supplying meter, which occurred yesterday (28/7/11).  They warned us we might have to pay another fee to the electrician for a circuitbreaker, which seems to be missing on the original meter.  All the workmen were very friendly and efficient, so we're hoping the sun will do its bit from now on.
panel_brand: Solar Photovoltaic System or Solar PV System (Other)
